crossRefs.note: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

translations.web: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
translations.bsb: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
translations.kjv: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
translations.asv: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined to the two ends thereof, that it may be joined together.
